title: KdV with almost periodic initial data
exact_target: Prove global and time-almost-periodic evolution for suitable almost-periodic KdV data and establish persistence under appropriate perturbations.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8100001 (AMR-080-0001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some Open Problems in Random Matrix Theory and the Theory of Integrable Systems. II, SIGMA 13 (2017), 016, Problem 1.
Primary full-text formulation and 2017 historical progress discussion.

status_qualification: The original source records partial progress for small analytic quasiperiodic data with Diophantine frequencies. Its words suitable perturbations and suitable data are part of a research programme; no unsupported universal perturbation class is imposed.
